slides.dek: The shade designers name most this year, broken into a four hex scheme.

slides.name: Warm Ivory
slides.body: Every wall and the ceiling. Chocolate needs a light room around it, and ivory keeps the scheme from tipping into a cave.

slides.name: Bitter Chocolate
slides.body: The sofa, an armchair, the rug field. Deep brown reads richer than black and warmer than grey, and it forgives wear like nothing else.

slides.name: Toffee
slides.body: Coffee table, chair frames, a leather strap or two. The bridge tone that keeps ivory and chocolate from splitting the room in half.

slides.name: Dried Olive
slides.body: One throw, a vase, the spines on a shelf. Muted green is the year's other favourite, and it keeps this much brown from feeling airless.

body: Keep chocolate at furniture height and below, with light walls rising above it. Rooms hold weight the way a landscape holds a horizon.
One thing to keep out: cool grey. Next to this much warmth it reads like a leftover from 2018.

slides.h: Save this for the sofa decision.
